name: dm_crater
label: Death Mountain Crater
about: Pieces and textures cut from Death Mountain Crater (spot17). Definitions only: the meshes come from the extract (ROM data) into out/. Coordinates are the builder's: x east, y north, z up (glTF's (x, -z, y)). See ADR 0036.

textures.about: Material N -> role (2026-10-09, from the textures and where the crater draws them; nearly all are shaded by vertex colours). `ground` is the crater's floors, `lava` the lava sea, `cliff` its big rock walls, `rock` the central rock mass and low walls, `rock_brick` the climbable south wall, `cliff_streak*` the dark walls by the passage, `rim`/`rim_b` the pale outer rim and `haze` the dark fade over it. The Fire Temple gatehouse is `column*`, `temple_*`, `goron_face`, `goron_ring`, `gate_*`, `mural`, `gold_relief`, its shaft `untextured` (vertex colour only) and `tunnel_rock`; the bridges are `plank*`, `post_wood*`, `post_top*`, `beam*` and `wood*`; the passage to the trail `passage_*` and `stairs` (translucent). No floor has a detail texture.

surfaces.about: Surface type -> collision role (oot_import::level::ROLES), where the default read off the type (kit::default_role) is wrong. Type 5 is the Fire Temple's doorway floor (exit 3), at the foot of its shaft.

pieces.name: dmc_fire_temple
pieces.label: Fire Temple entrance
pieces.about: The Goron-carved gatehouse on the crater's central rock: a barred gate under a rock arch, a corridor to a hall, and in it a shaft whose ladder (wall types 2 and 3) climbs 865 down to a tunnel and the Fire Temple's doorway floor (exit 3, mapped to door). The origin is the gate's floor; the shaft and tunnel hang below it, so it wants a high place or a pit. Spot17 draws its front in both rooms, so some triangles are doubled. Locked: the ladder is sized for Link.

pieces.name: dmc_trail_passage
pieces.label: Passage to the trail
pieces.about: The passage up to Death Mountain Trail: a short rock tunnel from the crater, then translucent stairs fading to dark (exit 1's floors start about 460 in). The origin is the mouth's floor, facing out. Locked.

pieces.name: dmc_plank_bridge
pieces.label: Plank bridge
pieces.about: The plank walkway across the lava in the west, with log crosspieces under it and a short climbable plank face (wall type 4) at its west end. Its width is locked; its length (y) may change.

pieces.name: dmc_plank_ladder
pieces.label: Plank ladder
pieces.about: A ladder of logs nailed between two posts (climbable as vines), 150 tall, up to the west ledge. Locked.

pieces.name: dmc_rope_bridge
pieces.label: Rope bridge
pieces.about: The slack plank bridge with a post at each corner, in the crater's west. Its width is locked; its length (y) may change.

pieces.name: dmc_ladder
pieces.label: Ladder
pieces.about: A plain ladder (wall type 2) 395 tall, on the cliff below the crater's south rim. Locked.

pieces.name: dmc_pillar
pieces.label: Wooden pillar
pieces.about: A tall pillar of stacked logs, 508 tall, standing in the lava by the Fire Temple's approach; its top is a small floor.

pieces.name: dmc_stone_platform
pieces.label: Stone platform
pieces.about: A tiled brick block standing in the lava, with a little carved marker stone on one corner.

pieces.name: dmc_rock_block
pieces.label: Rock block
pieces.about: A block of rock standing in the lava, its top edged with a translucent glowing rim.

pieces.name: dmc_plank_ramp
pieces.label: Plank ramp
pieces.about: A plank leaning from a small block down to the ground: a ramp onto a platform.
